mapper.sql: id, product_id, author_id, rating, content, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reviews (product_id, author_id, rating, content, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{productId}, #{authorId}, #{rating}, #{content}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM reviews WHERE product_id = #{productId} ORDER BY id DESC
SELECT FROM reviews WHERE author_id = #{authorId} ORDER BY id DESC
SELECT product_id AS product_id, AVG(rating) AS average FROM reviews GROUP BY product_id
